audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain is called 'his E flip' in nine strings and tracked as the matchup-defining cooldown, but neither layer ever mentions that it shields him.
audit.why: Disdain charges Urgot forward WITH a shield on, tramples non-champions, and stops dead on the first champion it catches to hurl them behind him. The shield is the half that decides the matchup for Ambessa: her damage arrives as one compressed Q-into-empowered-auto burst, and a fresh Disdain absorbs exactly that window. 'Dash his flip' treats it purely as displacement, so a player who successfully dodges the flip still bursts into the shield and wonders why the trade lost. Forcing it out on nothing first is the whole play, and 16s at rank 1 makes that a countable window.
audit.corrected: Disdain (E), 16/15.5/15/14.5/14, 475 range: a shielded charge that stops on the first champion and hurls them behind him. Bait the shield out, then burst into the 16s hole.
sources: champ-data/_kits/urgot.json — E Disdain 'charges in a direction, shielding himself', flags shield/hardCC, cd 16/15.5/15/14.5/14

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings describe Purge as percent-max-HP damage: 'his W shotgun legs grind percent-max-HP', 'his percent-HP W poke', 'W percent-max-HP legs', 'his percent-HP W damage'.
audit.why: Riot's Purge text has no percent-health component at all — it is repeated physical damage that prioritises champions he has recently struck with another ability and triggers Echoing Flames. The mislabel matters because percent-health damage would make health stacking pointless and imply the damage is unavoidable, which is the opposite of the truth. The genuinely exploitable fact is missing instead: Purge SLOWS URGOT while he fires it. His DPS window is also the one moment he cannot follow you, so stepping out sideways beats it, and his own kit hands you the disengage.
audit.corrected: Purge (W), 12/9/6/3/0, 490 range: repeated physical damage that slows Urgot himself while he fires. Step out during the channel — he is the slow one.
sources: champ-data/_kits/urgot.json — W Purge: 'Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies', flags slow only, cd 12/9/6/3/0

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gives no numbers at all — 'His engage. Dash it. Your committal tool: never spend it on chip.'
audit.why: Urgot's cooldown profile is the most unusual thing about him and it is unstated. Purge goes from 12 seconds at rank 1 to ZERO at rank 5, and its cost falls to nothing with it, so 'wait for his W' stops being a plan as the lane goes on — which is precisely why the entry's own advice to keep fights short is correct, and why it should be tied to his W rank rather than left as a feeling. Corrosive Charge is 10s at rank 1 from 800 range, and Disdain is 16s. Those three numbers turn the whole page from advice into a schedule.
audit.corrected: Corrosive Charge 10s at rank 1, 800 range; Disdain 16s at rank 1; Purge 12s at rank 1 falling to 0s at rank 5. Bait Disdain, burst inside its 16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings credit Ambessa with 'R passive armor pen' and one adds 'on-ability healing' (spikes[2].text, whys[5], mid, late, wants.you[0]).
audit.why: Riot's Public Execution text grants neither. It blinks her to the farthest enemy champion in a chosen line, suppresses on arrival, then slams for damage and a stun — no armour penetration, no healing. The kit file's 'heal' flag on R is a tooltip-parsing misfire (see notes). The claim is load-bearing here: 'your armor pen cuts the bruiser-tank build' is the entry's stated answer to Urgot stacking resistances, so a player follows it into a fight where the counter does not exist. I replaced it with the verified play — force the Disdain shield out first — rather than asserting a negative.
audit.corrected: Public Execution (R), 1250 range, 130/115/100: blink to the farthest champion in the chosen line, suppress, slam for damage and a stun. No armour pen, no heal in Riot's text.

audit.why: HARD at 7.5/10 fits: he owns levels 1-5 on a free 800-range Corrosive Charge and shorter cooldowns, she gets one real window at 6 and Eclipse, and he reclaims parity as Purge's cooldown collapses. The two layers already agree stage-for-stage on all seven sides. No side changed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The four spikes name the right moments but two of them justify the spike with mechanics that do not exist (R armour pen at first item, percent-max-HP Purge late).
audit.why: A spike card is only useful if the reason is the real reason — a player who believes armour pen carries her first-item window will build and commit around a stat she does not have. The genuine first-item argument is that Disdain is 16s and can be emptied before the burst, and the genuine late argument is that Purge reaches zero cooldown at rank 5 while his R impales and executes a low target.
audit.corrected: 1st item: bait the 16s Disdain shield, then Q-auto-Slam into the hole. Late: Purge hits 0s at rank 5 and his R executes low targets — keep every fight inside one burst.
sources: champ-data/_kits/urgot.json — E cd 16, W cd 12/9/6/3/0, R execute flag

edits.before: Urgot owns the first few levels — his Q (Corrosive Charge) drops a free ranged explosion-and-slow on you while you have one ability, a long cooldown, and no combo to answer with. Don't walk into Q range trying to last-hit; you'll eat the explosion and his W shotgun-leg follow-up for nothing. Farm with the outer edge of your Q cone, take the chip, and wait — once you have Cunning Sweep into Lacerate and your Drakehound's Step dash online around 3 you can weave one quick empowered auto and disengage before his W legs lock fully onto you, but don't commit to anything extended yet.

Farm with the outer edge of your Q cone, take the chip, and wait — once Cunning Sweep into Lacerate and your Drakehound's Step dash are online around 3 you can weave one quick empowered auto and leave. notes: UNVERIFIED, LEFT INTACT: four strings state that Public Execution's suppression makes Ambessa immune to Disdain's flip while she is channelling ('suppresses straight through his E flip — the flip he wants to land on you does nothing while you're channeling'). Nothing in either kit file settles CC priority or displacement immunity during her R, so I neither reinforced nor removed the claim: I left content.mid, whys[4] and spikes[1].text UNEDITED because the claim is the whole point of each of them. The cost of that decision is that content.mid still carries the invented 'R passive armor pen plus on-ability healing' phrase — it could not be removed without also rewriting the suppression sentence around it. It needs a human ruling, then a one-line follow-up edit. KIT-FILE FLAG MISFIRE: champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json tags Public Execution with 'heal' and tags W and R with 'grounding'; Riot's descriptions support none of them and the 'heal' flag has clearly leaked into this entry as 'on-ability healing'. WIN RATE: MC_WR_TABLES.ambessa.urgot is 44.56 while the packet reports 50.72 over 278 games. No win-rate edit proposed. Existing text puts Urgot's execute threshold at 25%; Riot's Data Dragon text says only 'below a health threshold', so I used no number in anything I rewrote.
